snippet.title: The Hambagu Shop Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3461920/The_Boba_Teashop/
Itch: https://miketendev.itch.io/the-hambagu-shop

The Hambagu Shop is a cozy horror narrative simulator where you work in a Japanese Hamburg Steak Shop. Cook Hamburg, serve customers, and upgrade your shop for more menu items.
